text: for very age: Heb. multitude of days
the West country: Heb. the country of the going down of the Sun
no hire for man: Or, the hire of man became nothing. etc.
execute the judgment of truth and peace: Heb. judge truth, and the judgment of peace
feasts: Heb. solemn, or set times
speedily: Or, continually. Heb. going | pray before: Heb. to intreat the face
